categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Changes block storage and block index pruning logic in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` and `src/node/blockstorage.h`.
categories.rationale: Consolidating block index traversals eliminates an O(M * N) loop holding `cs_main` that froze nodes for up to 10 minutes on startup when switching an existing chain to pruned mode. Author benchmarks show pruning time dropping from 606s to 26ms on a Raspberry Pi 5 and 75s to 15ms on x86 (>3,500x speedup).
